# ankra_proxmox_cluster (Resource)

Provisions a Kubernetes cluster on Proxmox VE virtual machines through the Ankra platform. The counterpart of `ankra cluster proxmox create`. Proxmox has no cloud controller, so the cluster carries no `external_cloud_provider` and no GitOps source at create. Provisioning arguments are immutable, so changing one forces replacement; add capacity in place with `ankra_node_group`.

Import by cluster id. The platform does not return the build arguments, so the first apply after an import adopts the configured values in place, without replacing the cluster: they must describe the cluster as it was built.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_proxmox_cluster" "example" {
  name                  = "proxmox-lab"
  credential_id         = "61262ddf-72db-4745-9a77-2c19961cf2d5"
  ssh_key_credential_id = "0f0f4d7e-2f0e-4f5a-9d6b-8c1a2b3c4d5e"

  # Hosts, bridges, storages and templates:
  # `ankra cluster proxmox hosts|bridges|storages|templates --credential-id <id>`.
  node    = "pve1"
  bridge  = "vmbr0"
  storage = "local-lvm"

  control_plane_count         = 3
  control_plane_instance_type = "px-medium"
  worker_count                = 2
  worker_instance_type        = "px-large"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bridge` (String) Network bridge the VMs attach to (e.g. `vmbr0`).
- `credential_id` (String) Proxmox VE credential id used to provision the cluster.
- `name` (String) Name of the cluster.
- `node` (String) Proxmox host the cluster's VMs are created on.
- `ssh_key_credential_id` (String) SSH key credential id to install on the VMs.

### Optional

- `bastion_instance_type` (String) Size of the bastion VM.
- `cni` (String) Container network interface. Defaults to `cilium`, the only CNI kubeadm clusters run; set `flannel` or `calico` for k3s clusters.
- `control_plane_count` (Number) Number of control-plane nodes.
- `control_plane_instance_type` (String) Size of control-plane VMs.
- `description` (String) Description of the cluster.
- `distribution` (String) Kubernetes distribution: `kubeadm` (default, vanilla upstream Kubernetes) or `k3s`.
- `etcd_instance_type` (String) Size of dedicated etcd VMs.
- `etcd_node_count` (Number) Number of dedicated etcd nodes when `etcd_topology` is `external`.
- `etcd_topology` (String) etcd topology for kubeadm clusters: `stacked` or `external`.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Send `force=true` when deprovisioning, which makes the platform tear down the cluster's Proxmox VE resources without its usual guards. Defaults to `false`, the guarded delete path. Changing this only affects a future destroy, so it never replaces the cluster.
- `include_dns` (Boolean) Delegate a DNS subzone to the cluster and wire external-dns into the networking stack.
- `include_networking` (Boolean) Install the Ankra networking stack (Traefik and cert-manager) for ingress.
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version. Defaults to the platform's stable version when unset; `data.ankra_kubernetes_versions` lists the supported ones.
- `network_mode` (String) Put the cluster on the platform WireGuard overlay behind its bastion site gateway: `private_network` or `wireguard_mesh`. kubeadm only; requires `site_public_ip`.
- `placement_nodes` (List of String) Two or more Proxmox hosts to spread the cluster's VMs across. Unset keeps every VM on `node`.
- `site_public_ip` (String) Public address of the site gateway for `network_mode`.
- `storage` (String) Storage the VM disks are created on.
- `template` (String) VM template to clone. Unset lets the platform pick the first available template on the node.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Wait for the platform to report the cluster `running` before the resource is considered created. Defaults to `true`; set it to `false` to return as soon as the platform accepts the request. Anything that consumes the cluster - a kubeconfig, a `kubernetes` provider, a dependent module - needs the wait, because provisioning is asynchronous.
- `worker_count` (Number) Number of worker nodes in the cluster's default worker group. Further groups, and in-place resizing, are `ankra_node_group` resources.
- `worker_instance_type` (String) Size of the default worker group's VMs.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier assigned to the cluster by the Ankra platform.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the cluster (mirrors `cluster_id`).
- `kind` (String) Cluster kind the platform reports (for example `hetzner`, `imported`).
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the cluster belongs to: the provider's `project_id`, resolved to an ID when it is a slug, since the platform shows a cluster only in its own project. Null when the provider sets no `project_id`. Moving a cluster to another project is not managed here; after a move the cluster is no longer visible in this project.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state the platform reports for the cluster, refreshed on every read (for example `creating`, `running`, `stopped`).

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Proxmox VE clusters are imported by their Ankra platform cluster id.
terraform import ankra_proxmox_cluster.example ef8cf93e-1d97-4494-9de4-12ced709ffde
```
